title: Test Cases for a Story
description: test-cases/[story-id].json. The Test Designer's primary output. Every TC carries an Automation Decision with a non-empty reason; see docs/automation-decision-model.md. Risk linkage is mandatory; see docs/traceability.md.

automation_decision_reason.description: Non-empty. Must be a real explanation, not a restatement of the decision. Generic reasons are a Gate 2 rejection per docs/review-gates.md.

step_id.description: e.g. 'S-01', 'S-02'. Stable inside this test case.

data.description: Optional. Free-form input data for the step.

design_stage.description: OPTIONAL (Phase 2.6 TG2.6-4, shift-left). The lifecycle stage at which this case was designed. 'pre_development' = produced during refinement, before code exists (acts as a shared acceptance contract); 'ready_for_qa' = revisited/validated once the implementation exists. Absent => treated as ready_for_qa (the single-entry-point default). Orthogonal to 'status' (the Gate-2 approval state).

qmetry_fields.description: Reserved forward-compatibility slot. Phase 1 leaves this empty; future phases may bind a schema.

testlink_id.description: Populated by Phase 2 syncing-testlink skill. Empty/omitted in Phase 1. DEPRECATED in favor of external_ids.testlink (Phase 2.6) but kept valid for backward compatibility; the TestLink adapter still writes it.

external_ids.description: Phase 2.6 (TG2.6-3). Generic tool -> external id linkage written back by a TestManagementAdapter after a push (e.g. {"jira": "SK-50", "qase": "123"}). Open/Closed: a new adapter records its id here without adding a new per-tool field. testlink_id remains the TestLink adapter's dedicated field for compatibility; new adapters use this object. Keys are tool names; values are the tool's issue/case id.

api_metadata.description: API-branch extension. Optional. Populated only when automation_decision == 'automate_api'; E2E-only cases leave this unset.

syncState.description: Optional. Per-target record of external synchronization (task group 5.1), keyed by target tool (e.g. "jira", "testlink"). Written by the adapters in scripts/ so a create survives a later failure: the intent is saved before the request and the remote id immediately after it. Never holds credentials. Like testlink_id and external_ids, it records WHERE a case was pushed, not WHAT it says, so it never invalidates an approval. The same shape is used in bug drafts (docs/bug-draft-format.md, "## Sync State").

marker.description: Short digest of operation_key, sent with the create so an uncertain outcome can be reconciled by a read-only remote search.

marker_searchable.description: false when the remote rejected the field carrying the marker and the create was resent without it; such an operation can only be resolved by a human.

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical payload last sent (or about to be sent).

source_digest.description: SHA-256 of the local item's content (without its sync linkage) when it was pushed. A later difference means the local item changed after the push; adapters report it and never update the remote copy (task group 5.2).

state.description: pending: intent saved, outcome not yet known. created: remote id known. failed: the remote definitely rejected the create (nothing exists). not_found: a pending operation was reconciled and nothing exists remotely.

link_state.description: Optional follow-up link to the story issue. A failed link is retried on a later run without recreating the item.

last_error.description: Sanitized diagnostic of the last failure. Never contains credentials.
